title: Pretty Flimsy
text: Pretty Flimsy. I'm not in love with these bags. They are pretty flimsy and not well made. No reinforced bottoms to help them stand up. They are also very long and not too tall. This presents a problem if you use the self checkouts. These bags don't fit on the sensor well at all and hang out everywhere causing read errors.  Not the best shopping bags I have ever gotten.
